Definition
[Dual point]

1. ch2:2.2.4-def-4\group Green’s Functions

For $x\ne 0$, the point \[ \overline x:=\frac{x}{|x|^2} \] is dual to $x$ under inversion through $\partial B(0,1)$.

For $|y|=1$, one has $|x|^2|y-\overline x|^2=|x-y|^2$.
